checks.explanation: Union resistance did materialize (by May 2026 the AFT called for AI rollbacks in classrooms, restrictions on student AI tools, and a 'Big Tech Tax'), but overall teacher AI adoption actually surged to 61% in 2025, and there's no data confirming the claim that union resistance is causing the US to fall behind education systems abroad.
